text:
Situation: Corvale East holds 71 units of regadenoson 0.08 mg/mL 5 mL syringes with daily use of 3.3 units, providing 21.4 days on hand as of 2026-10-21.

Why (FDA record): FDA's shortage database does not list regadenoson as of 2026-10-21.

Our position: Current inventory covers approximately three weeks. No FDA shortage designation exists. Multiple manufacturers report product available and not on the FDA shortage list.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to place orders with Astellas Pharma US, Inc. (plants: Astellas) — requires buyer approval.
2. Buyer to place orders with Hikma Pharmaceuticals USA Inc. (plant: Berkeley Heights) — requires buyer approval.
3. Buyer to place orders with Accord Healthcare Inc. — requires buyer approval.
4. Buyer to place orders with Apotex Corp. — requires buyer approval.
5. Buyer to place orders with Baxter Healthcare Corporation — requires buyer approval.

Not recommended: No clinical protocol changes or alternative agent substitutions at this time; those decisions remain with the treating clinicians and the committee.
